verdict.rationale: The docs say mise keeps multiple tool versions on one machine and switches between them per project. They also say it installs a tool only 'if it is not already installed'. Together this implies each tool version is installed once and reused across projects. Nothing describes a content-addressable store or deduplication, and the evidence covers runtimes and CLI tools, not project dependencies. missing for 10: an explicit content-addressable store, a documented shared install location with deduplication semantics, coverage of project-level dependencies (not just tools), and independent or hands-on corroboration of disk savings.
